question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel alongside SMS, or as an externally distributed ClawHub plugin using the existing channel SDK?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally provider-specific and already relies on plugin seams, while repository policy directs optional channels and service workflows outside core when those seams are sufficient. This is a product and ownership commitment rather than a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Route to ClawHub
options.body: Move the RCS package to ClawHub and retain only any demonstrably missing generic SDK seam in core.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept the bundled channel commitment, then require exact-head dependency approval, security review, and carrier/device proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Route to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Move the RCS package to ClawHub and retain only any demonstrably missing generic SDK seam in core.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent bundled Twilio SMS channel and are the strongest history-based routing candidate for deciding whether RCS shares that distribution boundary.
